evals.name: blank-page-fr
evals.prompt: bon j'ai envie de faire un side project mais j'ai aucune idée, tu peux m'aider ?
evals.expected_output: Blank-page branch. One sentence of orientation, then two or three questions through the question tool (or the 1️⃣ chat format without one) with lettered options and Autre on the next free letter. No file written.

evals.name: pain-en
evals.prompt: every sunday my partner and I lose 20 minutes deciding who does what at home this week, feels like there's a product in there but it's fuzzy
evals.expected_output: Pain branch, in English. Starts from who suffers and when, in concrete situations, before any solution. Questions through the question tool (or the 1️⃣ chat format without one).

evals.name: clear-idea-game
evals.prompt: I want to build a small roguelike where you play a bee defending a hive against wasps, each run is one day, I've got the whole thing in my head already, just help me write it down properly
evals.expected_output: Idea-already-there branch. At most three questions, only for empty slots. Game slots used. No digging into mechanics.

evals.name: newsletter-content
evals.prompt: je pense à lancer une newsletter hebdo sur les outils IA pour les indépendants, aide-moi à cadrer l'idée
evals.expected_output: Kind content, with its slots: format and rhythm, what the reader takes away, why you. Questions through the question tool (or the 1️⃣ chat format without one) with lettered options.

evals.name: existing-idea-file
evals.prompt: je veux un jeu de gestion, mais je sais pas trop de quoi, aide moi (simulate the full interview with short invented user answers until the user confirms the page, then finish)
evals.expected_output: Full run in a directory where .veebee/idea.md already exists: at the finish, the skill shows the existing title and offers fresh directory or overwrite, and writes nothing until the user answers.

evals.name: async-card-persistence
evals.prompt: Runtime: Default mode, request_user_input is Plan-only, request_user_input_async returns immediately. User: my shopping list is useless. Ask the next question.
evals.expected_output: Do not invoke either question tool. Final reply includes the full question, concrete lettered options, and Other. Stop and await the answer.

evals.name: missing-card-recovery
evals.prompt: Previous question: What is hardest? a choosing meals, b remembering ingredients, c shopping time, d Other. User: the question card disappeared.
evals.expected_output: Repeat that same question and all four options in the final chat reply, preserving their order. No temporary card, no assumed answer or interview progression.

assertions: Never more than five questions in one assistant turn, never fewer than two after the opening question, except when fewer slots are still open

Every closed question uses a callable blocking question tool only when allowed in the current mode (no Other option added, suggested option first and recommended); otherwise the complete question and lettered options appear in the final chat reply, ending with Autre/Other unless the second yes/no option is open. Asynchronous question tools are not used.
No option ever mentions /challenge or another skill
The final idea.md starts with a YAML front-matter carrying kind, title and lang
When .veebee/idea.md already exists, nothing is written before the user chooses between a fresh directory and overwriting
Without the Artifact tool, nothing is opened during the interview; the Idea is shown in the chat as headed sections at the finish, and the browser page is opened at most once, then
Every turn that asks a question ends with the question; the skill never continues as if the user had answered
A picked option followed by free text is read as that option refined by the text, not as a different answer
